title: MCP Sampling — Server-Requested LLM Completions and Agent Loops

questions.question: How many sampling requests does summarize_repo_tool make?
options: Exactly two: one to pick files and one to summarize them
Exactly three, one per selected file
Exactly one, because the repository is already indexed
Five, because SamplingBudget starts at five
questions.explanation: The tool first asks the model to pick files, then asks it to summarize the combined content, for two samples total.

questions.question: What does the canned pick response select?
options: main.py, tests/test_main.py, and pyproject.toml
README.md, server.py, and docs/intro.md
Every file in FAKE_REPO
Only docs/intro.md
questions.explanation: CANNED_RESPONSES['pick'] is the JSON list README.md, server.py, docs/intro.md.

questions.question: Which preferences accompany the first pick request?
options: Only a max_tokens value of 512
cost 0.2, speed 0.2, intelligence 0.6, with a sonnet hint
cost 0.5, speed 0.3, intelligence 0.2, with a haiku hint
A request for the provider to execute tools
questions.explanation: The file-selection request uses the cost/speed/intelligence weights .5/.3/.2, asks for a haiku-like model, and limits output to 256 tokens.

questions.question: What does the second summarize request receive?
options: The original user question with no file contents
A single selected filename and max_tokens 64
The pick JSON as an unparsed string
selected files + sonnet + max_tokens=512
questions.explanation: The second request includes the chosen files' contents and uses preferences .2/.2/.6, a sonnet hint, and 512 maximum tokens.

questions.question: What metadata does summarize_repo_tool attach to its final result?
options: _meta.samplesUsed equal to 2
_meta.samplesUsed equal to 0
A live OAuth access token
The full SamplingBudget object
questions.explanation: After the pick and summarize calls, the returned content includes metadata recording samplesUsed: 2.

questions.question: What happens when SamplingBudget.sample is called after five uses?
options: It silently reuses the fifth response
sixth sample raises RuntimeError
It resets used to zero
It switches to a real model API
questions.explanation: SamplingBudget has max5 and rejects a sixth sample, preventing an accidental unbounded server-requested loop.
